description: Add a heartbeat for a scheduled job. Returns ping URLs: success at the end, /start at the beginning, /fail or /<exit code> on failure. A missed ping alerts the owner. Keep the URLs secret (job config, not public code). Needs write access.

app.description: The app: its slug, name, domain (shop.app), URL or id. list_apps shows them all.

cron.description: Cron expression in UTC, like 0 3 * * *. Use this or every_hours.

every_hours.description: Runs every N hours (0.0167 = every minute). Use this or cron.

grace_minutes.description: How late it may be before BugOtter alerts

name: add_heartbeat
title: Watch a cron job
